blocks.text: Gate the exact candidate evidence against predeclared requirements. Aggregate improvement cannot replace complete, passing quality and operating predicates.

Before promotion, compare the candidate with the accepted reference and predeclared requirements. Evaluate every supplied acceptance predicate and identify failures. Calculate validation expected error cost with fixed deployment probabilities and error costs; include fixed latency and operating limits in eligibility.

Failed or incomplete required gates block promotion. For binary validation counts, FPR = FP/(FP+TN) and FNR = FN/(FN+TP). FPR conditions on actual negatives; FNR conditions on actual positives. If either denominator is zero, its rate is undefined and the required gate cannot pass. With zero cost for correct predictions, expected error cost = P(Y=0) × FPR × cost_FP + P(Y=1) × FNR × cost_FN, using the supplied deployment probabilities and error costs.

blocks.text: With declared PyYAML, import yaml. Write mapping/list configuration with yaml.safe_dump(config, file_handle), reload with yaml.safe_load(file_handle), and inspect required resolved fields before runtime submission. Safe loading accepts standard YAML tags, not arbitrary Python object constructors.

Reconcile only declared named uploads. Use blob.exists(), blob.reload() and generation to retrieve bytes; verify expected hash and required validation. Skip only verified completed uploads. Create missing output with blob.upload_from_filename(path, if_generation_match=0). On 412, re-read and verify, never overwrite; conflicts or failed validation stop recovery.
